issues.explanation: The adaptation says the defeated and killed attacker is 秦朗, after correctly identifying the supposed 秦朗 as his brother 秦明 in disguise. This leaves the identity of the slain officer contradictory and unclear.
issues.suggested_fix: After the identification, consistently call the attacker 秦明, or state that “冒充秦朗的秦明” was killed; reserve 秦朗 for the officer whose identity he impersonated.
